args.request: Could you make a reel from these five café photos I’ve attached? ... a 10-second vertical Instagram reel, using all five pictures in the order attached: the storefront pic, the latte pic, the pastries pic, the barista pic, and the interior pic. Please add some relaxed instrumental music to go with them. ... There shouldn’t be any text, just nice smooth transitions between the photos.

story.title: Café reel
story.setting: A cozy neighborhood café in soft natural daylight, warm and relaxed photographic look.

subjects.words: the café storefront with a navy and cream striped awning and wooden bistro tables outside
a latte with a white heart of foam and a green leaf on a white marble table
golden croissants in a glass display case on a wooden counter
a dark-haired barista in a black t-shirt pouring milk at an espresso machine
the café interior with hanging plants, pendant lamps and guests at wooden tables

beats.text: Slow gentle push-in on the storefront.
Slow gentle drift over the latte, a wisp of steam rises.
Slow gentle pan across the croissants in the display case.
The barista calmly pours steamed milk into the cup.
Slow gentle pull-back through the café interior, plants sway softly.

story.music: relaxed instrumental café music, soft acoustic guitar and light piano

text:
Your café reel is ready. It's vertical, has no text, and has soft instrumental music with acoustic guitar and light piano under the whole thing:
http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/e4cb10a513414d6f9cef646182a13fb0.mp4

It runs in your order: storefront → latte → pastries → barista → interior. Each photo became a short moving shot with a slow push-in, rising steam, a pan across the croissants, the barista pouring and a slow pull-back through the room.

A few things don't match what you asked for:
- **Length:** it's about 11.7 seconds, not 10. The joining step came out longer than planned, and I can't trim it here. You can cut the last 1.7 seconds in Instagram's editor when you post it.
- **Transitions:** the shots change with straight cuts, not dissolves. The tool I used can't make crossfades. A crossfade transition in Instagram's editor will give you the smooth look.
- **Your photos are redrawn:** the AI used each photo as a guide and made a new moving vertical shot from it. It isn't your exact photo animated. Most of your photos aren't vertical, so details like the awning stripes, faces or the latte art may look a bit different from the originals. I couldn't watch the result, so please check it.
- **Quality:** it's 480×858, the highest resolution the free plan allows.

This used 255 credits. If any shot drifts too far from your photo, tell me which one and I'll remake it.
